headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 12, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins secured a thrilling 7-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Dylan Beavers leading the Orioles' offense. The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies, winning 7-1 behind Alec Burleson's 2 hits and 3 RBIs. The Tampa Bay Rays took down the Athletics 8-4, led by Liam Hicks' 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. The San Francisco Giants transferred Matt Chapman to the 60-day injured list due to an abdominal strain, while Trevor McDonald was also moved to the 60-day injured list with a right elbow strain. The Detroit Tigers placed James Outman on the 7-day injured list with a concussion and Riley Greene on the 10-day injured list with a right hamstring strain. Other teams have also suffered injuries, including the Boston Red Sox, Pittsburgh Pirates, and Toronto Blue Jays.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place, shaking up teams' lineups. The Baltimore Orioles acquired Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox, while the Kansas City Royals received Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Athletics traded for Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies, and the Miami Marlins made a trio of trades involving Lake Bachar, Brandan Bidois, Brian Sanchez, and Hyun Seung Lee.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Orioles in Thrilling 7-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 5-7 win over the Baltimore Orioles, with Dylan Beavers leading the Orioles' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Phillies 7-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies, securing a 7-1 victory. Alec Burleson led the Phillies' offense with 2 hits and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Athletics 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured an 8-4 victory over the Athletics, with Liam Hicks leading the offense. Hicks finished with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs in 5 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Rockies Take Down Diamondbacks 6-4**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies secured a 6-4 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with Ryan Feltner earning the win. Brett Sullivan led the Rockies' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Impact players for the Tigers included Riley Greene, Spencer Torkelson, and James Outman.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past White Sox 9-8**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a thrilling 9-8 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with multiple players contributing to the win. Impact hitters for the Reds included Sal Stewart, Tyler Stephenson, Eugenio Suárez, Chase Meidroth, Randal Grichuk, Edgar Quero, and Sam Antonacci.

top_news.title: **Matt Chapman Shifts to 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants third baseman Matt Chapman has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to an abdominal strain. This move follows his initial placement on the 10-day injured list.

top_news.title: **Rivas Traded to Orioles**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles acquired CF Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox in a trade. The deal is part of the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade, with a player to be named later still to be determined.
